headline: Khaitan & Co acts on Bgauss ₹110 crore Series D fundraise
sum: Bgauss Auto Private Limited has raises ₹110 crore (~$11.6 million) from a Series D fundraise led by its founder, Hemant Mahendrakumar Kabra, with participation from existing investor Bharat Value Fund and two other investors. Khaitan & Co…
detail: Bgauss Auto Private Limited has raises ₹110 crore (~$11.6 million) from a Series D fundraise led by its founder, Hemant Mahendrakumar Kabra, with participation from existing investor Bharat Value Fund and two other investors. Khaitan & Co advised Bgauss on this fundraise. The transaction team consisted of Bhavik Narsana (Partner), Ipshita Dey (Senior Associate), Associates Pragya Mishra and Sakshi Mehta. Bgauss Founded by Hemant Kabra in 2020, BGauss is an electric two-wheeler manufacturer, operating as a subsidiary of RR Global.
